findings.issue: The initial validator checked final_step and the observation grid but accepted an arbitrary finite final_time_au. Its initial nominal fixture used 1 au despite the fixed 200 fs duration.
findings.resolution: The final raw clock must agree with 200*FS_TO_AU within gamma_(N+4)*abs(target_time), where gamma_m=m*eps/(1-m*eps), N=2000 or 4000, and eps is float64 machine epsilon. The positive-addition/constant-conversion bound was derived before any P256 child observations. A wrong-clock fixture and two pure arithmetic recurrence cases now cover this contract.

limitations: This review is not a P256 transmission/rate result or a scientific convergence certificate.
Only the separately authorized completed cohort can proceed to the reviewed full-cohort analyzer; this coordinator performs no automatic analysis.
A forced process termination can leave an uncommitted chunk or unavailable worker receipt; committed raw artifacts remain, and the attempt is not automatically retried.
The independent bounded native/Python physical validation requested by root is a separate gate, outside this read-only review.

verified_contracts: The fixed complete eight-parent manifest, nested parent routes, P128 complete four-pair baseline, external PES library/build identity, current source snapshots and runtime are bound before dispatch.

Each of eight seeds runs exactly the four registered branches in order: batch 0 dt 0.1, batch 0 dt 0.05, batch 1 dt 0.1, batch 1 dt 0.05; each branch has 200 parents and two antithetic momentum pairs.

Each child NPZ requires its full-array integrity envelope plus the report-bound whole-file SHA. Fixed shapes, parent/sweep order, pair indices, observation grid, native/final steps and physical end clock are checked.
Initial-momentum and equivalent-channel hashes must match chunk by chunk between the two timesteps for each pair batch.
The global inventory requires 32 unique reports/settings, 800 unique ordered chunks and 76,800,000 native physical steps. These counts are not treated as independent statistical replicas.

Whole registration/parent/source hashes are rechecked at admission, between branches and before final eligibility publication. The wrapper does not invoke the rate analyzer or use rate values to select or stop jobs.

Only a worker with the registered current parent PID and inherited coordinator process token can enter. A per-seed exclusive new claim and rejection of any existing branch prevent repeated dispatch or implicit resume.

The reviewed dispatcher 7934c1d7 is reused unchanged. It stops admissions after observed error, signal or deadline, records children before later journal operations, and stops/reaps only its owned start_new_session process groups.

On an error or deadline, drain means SIGTERM followed by a bounded SIGKILL fallback when necessary, not natural completion of every branch. The new worker records an interrupted failure/resource receipt when possible; an unavailable receipt remains explicit and prevents eligibility.
The directory lease is not automatically broken after hard crash or unconfirmed drain. A nonempty one-attempt output is never automatically resumed.

The separately chosen 10 hour wall budget includes startup/preflight and final audits, with a 120 second finalization reserve. Budget, source, receipt or audit failure leaves the cohort ineligible and retains data.

Successful global completion additionally requires all eight measured worker receipts, matching branch membership/native counts, one allowed CPU per worker and one thread per declared thread variable.
